name: Cenarion Aid
label: Quest
description: Cenarion Aid: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is the way of the divine to help those in need. The how is insignificant -- only the why matters.
The Cenarion Circle has such a need. Speak with Ogtinc to lend aid to their plight. He resides atop the cliffs to the northeast of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your arrival has lifted a weight from my shoulders. We have much to do.
